distractors: The reader API caps results at 500 records with a continuation token but never states an ordering guarantee across pages, so pagination can skip or repeat records.
Compression after seven days is specified without saying whether it is transparent to the reader API or requires a decompression step in the query path.
property: The specification keeps every captured inbound call body forever, because it says partitions are never dropped. The accepted design declares itself bound by policy POL-002, which classifies an inbound call body as identifying data and allows it to be kept for at most thirty days. A downstream specification cannot grant itself a longer limit.
summary: A specification stores request bodies indefinitely; the retention limit that forbids it lives in a policy the accepted design depends on and the contract never names.
